description: Unsigned transaction to take part or all of the wallet's money out of a farm. Run from the wallet first to show what comes back now, and what comes as the vault's own shares because borrowers have it out (they keep earning and redeem on Supply once it is free). Always works: never paused, no price feed needed.

percent.description: How much of the wallet's part to take out, 1 to 100 (default 100)

slip_bps.description: Least accepted under the preview, in hundredths of a percent (default 50, 0.5%)

symbol.description: A stock on Borro by its ticker, like NVDA or AAPL (markets lists every one)

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

name: farm_withdraw
title: Prepare: take money out of a farm
